subscribe.short: Subscribe channel to clan/family leaderboard updates
subscribe.title: 📊 Subscribe Command
subscribe.detailed:
Subscribe a Discord channel to receive automatic leaderboard updates for a clan or clan family.

**Usage:**
`/subscribe clan:<clan_tag_or_name> mode:<leaderboard_mode> [cwl_only:<true/false>] [current_year:<true/false>]`

**Parameters:**
• `clan` - Clan tag (e.g., #ABC123) or clan name, or family tag
• `mode` - Leaderboard mode (defaults to `attack` if omitted)
• `cwl_only` - Optional: Restrict subscription to CWL stats only (appends `_cwl` to the mode)
• `current_year` - Optional: Track the year-to-date period instead of the current month (default: false)

**Example:**
`/subscribe clan:#L2J0C0PY mode:attack`
`/subscribe clan:QCrew mode:avgstars current_year:true`

unsubscribe.title: 🔕 Unsubscribe Command
unsubscribe.detailed:
Remove a leaderboard subscription from the current Discord channel.

**Usage:**
`/unsubscribe clan:<clan_tag_or_name> [mode:<leaderboard_mode>] [current_year:<true/false>]`

**Parameters:**
• `clan` - Clan tag or name to unsubscribe from (or family tag)
• `mode` - Optional: Leaderboard mode to remove; if omitted, removes all modes subscribed for this clan/family
• `current_year` - Optional: `true` removes only the year-to-date subscription, `false` only the monthly one, omitted removes both

**Example:**
`/unsubscribe clan:#L2J0C0PY mode:attack`

subscriptions.short: List subscriptions for channel or server
subscriptions.title: 📋 Subscriptions Command
subscriptions.detailed:
Display all active leaderboard subscriptions for the current channel or entire server.

**Usage:**
`/subscriptions [server_wide:<true/false>]`

**Parameters:**
• `server_wide` - Optional: Show all server subscriptions (default: false, shows current channel only)

**Example:**
`/subscriptions` - Show channel subscriptions
`/subscriptions server_wide:true` - Show all server subscriptions

leaderboard.title: 🏆 Leaderboard Command
leaderboard.detailed:
Display a leaderboard for a specific clan or family with various statistics modes.

**Usage:**
`/leaderboard clan:<clan_tag_or_name> mode:<leaderboard_mode> [month:<month>] [year:<year>] [cwl_only:<true/false>] [season:<season>] [scope:<all|members|own>]`

**Parameters:**
• `clan` - Clan tag, name, or family tag. Leave empty to use this channel's subscriptions.
• `mode` - Leaderboard mode: attack, avgstars, avgstarsbyth, attackdefratio, defense, missedattacks, currentwar, cwlinfo, cwlinfo_comp, cwlgroup, raid, currentraid, raidmissed
• `month` - Optional: a single month (6), a range (6-7), a list (1;3;5), or a trailing count (-2 = last 2 months, may cross a year boundary)
• `year` - Optional: Specific year
• `cwl_only` - Optional: Restrict to CWL wars only (true/false)
• `season` - Optional: CWL season (YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD for mid-month CWL). Overrides month/year and forces CWL mode
• `scope` - Optional: `all` (default) lists everyone who fought for the clan, past members included, and credits current members' wars for other clans too; `members` lists current members only (their wars for any clan); `own` counts only the clan's own wars

**Available Modes:**
• `currentwar` - Ongoing war stats with win prediction
• `attack` - Sort by total war stars won (default)
• `avgstars` - Sort by average stars per attack
• `avgstarsbyth` - Average stars per attack, grouped by TH level
• `attackdefratio` - Ratio of stars won to defensive stars suffered
• `defense` - Fewest defensive stars conceded per defense
• `missedattacks` - Most missed attacks
• `cwlinfo` - CWL season: all 7 rounds with rosters, scores, and win predictions
• `cwlinfo_comp` - CWL overview: standard vs. skill-adjusted win predictions
• `cwlgroup` - CWL league-group standings: rank, stars, and destruction for all 8 clans
• `raid` - Clan Capital raid loot, attacks and medals per player (a raid weekend counts toward the month of its Friday)
• `currentraid` - Current (or last) raid weekend incl. players who haven't attacked yet
• `raidmissed` - Players who missed a raid weekend completely (0 attacks); without month/year the last weekend, otherwise missed weekends summed per player. Only players in the clan before the raid started count

**Example:**
`/leaderboard clan:#L2J0C0PY mode:attack month:12 year:2025`

highlightme.short: Highlight yourself in this channel's leaderboards (one-time)
highlightme.title: ✨ Highlight Me Command
highlightme.detailed:
Re-post this channel's subscribed leaderboards with your own registered player(s) bolded/colored so you can spot yourself in a long list.

**Usage:**
`/highlightme`

**Behavior:**
• Only leaderboards you actually appear in are reposted; others are left untouched
• `cwlinfo`, `cwlinfo_comp`, and `cwlgroup` subscriptions post embeds/images, not text tables, and can't be highlighted
• One-time only: the next automatic update cycle reposts the leaderboard again without the highlight

**If nothing happens:**
You'll get a small private message if this channel has no eligible leaderboard subscriptions, or if you're not listed in any of them.

**Example:**
`/highlightme`

analyse cwl_league_group.short: Analyse all clans in a CWL group
analyse cwl_league_group.title: ⚔️ Analyse League Group Command
analyse cwl_league_group.detailed:
Analyse all clans in a Clan War League (CWL) group and rank every player by offensive and defensive performance.

**Usage:**
`/analyse cwl_league_group clan:<clan_tag_or_name>`

**Parameters:**
• `clan` - Clan tag or name to look up the CWL league group for

**Information Displayed:**
• ⚔️ Top 10 best attackers — highest average stars on equal-or-higher TH targets
• 🛡️ Top 10 best defenders — fewest average stars conceded per defense
• Player names, tags, clans, clan tags, and performance values

**Note:**
This command works during or shortly after the CWL season. The autocomplete dropdown suggests tracked clans; any clan tag can also be typed directly.

**Example:**
`/analyse cwl_league_group clan:#L2J0C0PY`

analyse cwl_opponent.short: Analyse a CWL opponent clan's roster
analyse cwl_opponent.title: 🛡️ Analyse CWL Opponent Command
analyse cwl_opponent.detailed:
Analyse a CWL opponent clan's roster: per-player skill, reliability, and activity stats.

**Usage:**
`/analyse cwl_opponent clan:<clan_tag_or_name>`

**Parameters:**
• `clan` - Your clan tag or name to look up the CWL league group for

**Flow:**
1. Resolves your clan's current (or most recent) CWL league group
2. Shows an ephemeral dropdown listing the up to 7 opponent clans in the group
3. Select an opponent clan to see a per-player stats table

**Stats Displayed (per player, linked to in-game profile):**
• CWL Attack Skill = (3★ − 1★) / attacks × 100%
• CW Attack Skill = same formula for regular CW wars
• Reliability = attacks used / max attacks × 100%
• Activity = time-normalised attack participation rate

**Note:**
Roster is sourced from the live war lineup when available, or the most recent archived war/season data as a fallback.

**Example:**
`/analyse cwl_opponent clan:#L2J0C0PY`

clan management.title: 👥 Clan Management Command
clan management.detailed:
Open the interactive clan management panel. Displays all clan members with their TH level and Discord linking status. A clan selector dropdown lets you switch between all clans subscribed to this server. The view auto-selects the most active clan.

**Usage:**
`/clan management`

**Modes (selectable via dropdown):**
• ⚙️ Basic Configuration — Server language, war notification channel, and bot settings
• 🔗 Manage Registrations — Shows all clan members with verified/registered/unregistered status; Link Accounts button opens a paginated flow to link unlinked players to Discord users
• ⚔️ Manage War Notifications — Configure per-player war attack notification settings (whole clan or single user)
• 🎭 Manage Server Roles — Enable/disable auto-role system, configure CoC roles and clan roles
• 🏰 Manage Clan Families — Create, edit, and delete clan families; manage member clan assignments

**Notes:**
• Only server administrators can interact with the buttons and dropdowns
• The view is posted publicly (non-ephemeral) and replaces any previous clan management message in the channel
• View expires after 30 minutes and the message is automatically deleted

cwl preferences.short: Set your personal CWL / league preferences
cwl preferences.title: 🛡️ CWL Preferences Command
cwl preferences.detailed:
Opens your personal CWL preferences screen — set whether you want to always play CWL, never play, or decide fresh each season, plus a preferred league tier. Applies to every one of your linked Clash accounts individually, and to every server that invites you, not just this one.

**Usage:**
`/cwl preferences`

**Notes:**
• Works even if this server hasn't set up its Player CWL Settings Hub message — this command is always available
• A standing choice can still be overridden for any single season, either here or from that season's own invitation DM
• Also works in your DM with the bot: if your accounts belong to several servers, you first pick the server

dm me.short: Get a greeting DM from ClashControl with a quick intro
dm me.title: 👋 DM Me Command
dm me.detailed:
Sends you a private message from ClashControl: a short greeting, what the bot does and the first commands to try — handy to start a private conversation with the bot.

**Usage:**
`/dm me`

**Notes:**
• Works in a server and in your DM with the bot
• If nothing arrives, allow direct messages from server members in the server's Privacy Settings
• Server admins can send the same greeting to a member with `/admin` → DM User

admin.title: ⚙️ Admin Command
admin.detailed:
Administrative tools for bot configuration, diagnostics, and maintenance.

**Usage:**
`/admin action:<action_type>`

**Available Actions:**
• `Cleanup Messages` - Clean up bot messages in current server (Admin)
• `Cleanup Messages All` - Clean up all bot messages (Bot Admin)
• `Check Logs` - Scan and summarize error logs (Bot Admin)
• `Check Data` - Validate data consistency (Bot Admin)
• `List All Subscriptions` - View all subscriptions across servers (Bot Admin)
• `Test Notify` - Test war notifications (Bot Admin)
• `DM User` - Send the /dm me greeting DM to a server member (Admin, server only)
• `Remove Clan` - Remove clan from tracking (Admin)
• `List All Clans` - List all tracked clans (Admin)
• `Import Data` - Import player registrations from ClashPerk (Bot Admin)
• `Analyze Message` - Debug Discord message structure (Admin)
• `Refresh Data` - Force refresh all clan data from CoC API (Bot Admin)
• `Retrieve CWL Data` - Backfill CWL history for a clan (Bot Admin)
• `Backfill CWL Groups` - Fetch CWL league groups for clans with fewer than 7 rounds (Bot Admin)
• `War Prediction` - Predict war outcome between two clans (Bot Admin)
• `Start Update Cycle` - Skip sleep phase and start the next update cycle immediately (Bot Admin)
• `Execute Nightly Maintenance` - Run archive move + DB ANALYZE/REINDEX/VACUUM now (Bot Admin)
  ↳ `skip_db_maintenance:True` - only the data steps, without the long REINDEX/VACUUM/ANALYZE part
• `Memory Profile` - Dump memory allocation stats to the log file (Bot Admin)
• `Maintenance Start` - Suspend updates and close DB for safe data access (Bot Admin)
• `Maintenance End` - Restart bot and resume normal operation (Bot Admin)

**Permission Levels:**
• Admin - Requires Discord server administrator permission
• Bot Admin - Requires bot administrator role (configured in bot settings)

**Example:**
`/admin action:Cleanup Messages`

list.title: 📝 List Command
list.detailed:
List various data: Discord accounts with registered players, clan families, or all players in a clan/family.

**Usage:**
`/list action:<Accounts|Families|Players|Tracked Clans|Managed CWLs> [clan:<clan>] [family:<family>] [season:<season>] [discord_user:<@user>]`

**Actions:**

**Accounts** - List all Discord user accounts and their registered players
• Shows verification status
• Displays primary accounts
• Includes Town Hall levels
• `discord_user` parameter (optional): show only this one Discord user's accounts instead of everyone

**Families** - List all clan families and their member clans
• Shows family structure
• Lists all clans in each family

**Players** - List all players in a clan or family
• `clan` parameter: Specify clan tag or name
• `family` parameter: Specify family tag
• Shows player names, tags, and TH levels
• Displays Discord link status

**Tracked Clans** - Bar chart of all tracked clans grouped by war league
• Posted as an image to the channel

**Managed CWLs** (Bot Admin) - List every guild with a managed CWL for a season
• `season` parameter: CWL season as YYYY-MM — defaults to the next upcoming season if omitted

**Examples:**
`/list action:Accounts`
`/list action:Accounts discord_user:@SomeUser`
`/list action:Families`
`/list action:Players clan:#L2J0C0PY`
`/list action:Players family:#FAMILY123`
`/list action:Tracked Clans`
`/list action:Managed CWLs season:2026-09`

whois.short: Look up of Discord and CoC users and clan stats
whois.title: 🔍 Whois Command
whois.detailed:
Look up the Clash of Clans accounts registered to a Discord user, or show a full war performance report for any CoC player.

**Usage:**
`/whois user:<@user>` — registered CoC accounts for a Discord user
`/whois player:<#TAG>` — war history report for a specific player tag
`/whois player:<name>` — search by player name (case-insensitive substring); select from a list if multiple match

**Context Menu:**
Right-click any user → Apps → **whois**
Right-click any message → Apps → **whois** (looks up the message author)

**User lookup (Information Displayed):**
• All registered CoC player accounts (sorted by Town Hall level)
• Town Hall level with icon
• Hero levels (Barbarian King, Archer Queen, Grand Warden, Royal Champion, Minion Prince)
• Clan role and clan name
• Verification status (✅ verified / unverified)
• Primary account indicator

**Player report (Information Displayed):**
• Last known clan (name and tag)
• Total wars (CW / CWL), win/loss record
• Attacks used vs. missed, reliability %
• Average stars per attack, avg destruction %
• Full star distribution (0★ / 1★ / 2★ / 3★)
• Recent trend (last 10 CW wars vs. overall)
• CWL summary (seasons, wars, avg stars)
• Timeline of the last 10 wars

**Clan report (`/whois clan:<clan>`, tracked clans only):**
• Members, clan level, CWL and capital league, war log
• Wars stored by ClashControl (CW / CWL) with records and CWL seasons
• Tracked since, war tracking status, subscriptions, clan families and the servers it is a member clan on
• Dropdown: any leaderboard mode for this clan (current month), or back to the overview

**Examples:**
`/whois user:@SomeUser` - Look up a specific user's CoC accounts
`/whois player:#ABC123` - War history report for a CoC player tag
`/whois player:John` - Search for all players named John and pick one
`/whois clan:#2PP` - Stored data and leaderboards for a tracked clan

link clan.short: Post an in-game link to a clan's profile
link clan.title: 🔗 Link Clan Command
link clan.detailed:
Post a Clash of Clans in-game link that opens a clan's profile directly in the game.

**Usage:**
`/link clan clan:<tag or name>` — pick a clan from the list, or type a tag (e.g. `#ABC123`) or part of a clan name

**Output:**
`Clan Name: https://link.clashofclans.com/...` posted in the channel

**Examples:**
`/link clan clan:#L2J0C0PY`
`/link clan clan:QCrew`

registration.short: Link and manage your CoC player accounts
registration.title: 📝 Registration Command
registration.detailed:
Opens the registration hub with the same buttons as the server's registration message: link a Clash of Clans account, war notifications, API verification and your linked accounts.

**Usage:**
`/registration`

**Notes:**
• Only you can see the hub, in a server channel as well as in your DM with the bot, so channels don't fill up with registration messages
• In the DM, if you share several servers with the bot, you first pick the server you're registering for
• Linking from the DM gives you that server's roles, just like the server's registration message

link player.short: Post an in-game link to a player's profile
link player.title: 🔗 Link Player Command
link player.detailed:
Post a Clash of Clans in-game link that opens a player's profile directly in the game.

**Usage:**
`/link player player:<#TAG>` — a specific player tag
`/link player player:<name>` — search by player name (case-insensitive substring); select from a list if multiple match

**Output:**
`Player Name: https://link.clashofclans.com/...` posted in the channel

**Examples:**
`/link player player:#ABC123`
`/link player player:John`

about.short: What ClashControl does and how to get started
about.title: ℹ️ About Command
about.detailed:
Opens ClashControl's landing page as a Discord Activity: what the bot does, a button to add it to your own server, and the first commands for members and admins.

**Usage:**
`/about`

**Notes:**
• Works in a server and in your DM with the bot
• It's the same page Discord's **Launch** button on the bot's profile opens

ping.title: 🏓 Ping Command
ping.detailed:
Check the bot's response time and latency to Discord servers.

**Usage:**
`/ping`

**Information Displayed:**
• Bot latency (round-trip time)
• WebSocket heartbeat latency
• Response time

Useful for diagnosing connection issues or checking bot responsiveness.

status.title: 📊 Status Command
status.detailed:
Display comprehensive bot status information including uptime, memory usage, and cache statistics.

**Usage:**
`/status [force_refresh]`

**Parameters:**
• `force_refresh` (optional, default False) - Bypass the cached database statistics (normally up to 25h stale) and recompute them now. Takes several extra seconds since it re-scans the full war history database.

**Information Displayed:**
• Bot uptime (how long since last restart)
• Memory usage (RAM consumption)
• Number of tracked clans and families
• Registered Discord users and player accounts
• Active subscriptions count
• Cache statistics
• Last update times
• Nightly maintenance duration (min/avg/max over the last 10 runs this session; falls back to the last logged run until the first run completes)

Useful for monitoring bot health and performance.

help.title: ❓ Help Command
help.detailed:
Display help information about bot commands.

**Usage:**
`/help [command:<command_name>]`

**Parameters:**
• `command` - Optional: Specific command to get detailed help for

**Without parameters:**
Shows list of all available commands organized by category with short descriptions.

**With command parameter:**
Shows detailed help for the specified command including usage examples and parameter descriptions.

**Examples:**
`/help` - Show all commands
`/help command:subscribe` - Detailed help for subscribe command
`/help command:leaderboard` - Detailed help for leaderboard command

bug.short: Report a bug to the ClashControl maintainer
bug.title: 🐞 Bug Command
bug.detailed:
Open a modal to report a bug. Works in any server the bot is in, and in DMs.

**Usage:**
`/bug [attachment1:<file>] [attachment2:<file>] [attachment3:<file>]`

**Parameters:**
• `attachment1`/`attachment2`/`attachment3` - Optional: screenshots or log files (up to 3; more can be added afterwards via the item's **Add files** button)

**Flow:**
1. A modal opens for Title, Description, Steps to reproduce, and Environment (DEV/PROD/both)
2. Submitting shows a draft preview with Edit / Add attachments / Submit / Discard buttons
3. Submit posts the bug into the tracker channel with a global `#NNNN` id and opens a discussion thread

**Example:**
`/bug`

feature.short: Request a feature for ClashControl (incl. additional languages)
feature.title: 💡 Feature Command
feature.detailed:
Open a modal to request a feature. Works in any server the bot is in, and in DMs.

**Usage:**
`/feature [attachment1:<file>] [attachment2:<file>] [attachment3:<file>]`

**Parameters:**
• `attachment1`/`attachment2`/`attachment3` - Optional: screenshots or mockups (up to 3; more can be added afterwards via the item's **Add files** button)

**Flow:**
1. A modal opens for Title, Description, and Why is this useful?
2. Submitting shows a draft preview with Edit / Add attachments / Submit / Discard buttons
3. Submit posts the request into the tracker channel with a global `#NNNN` id and opens a discussion thread

**Languages:**
Missing your language? Request it with `/feature` — we will gladly add it.

**Example:**
`/feature`

management.help_overview_description:
**1️⃣ Setup** — Configure participating clans (roster size, CWL start time) and optionally assign standing CWL Coordinators. Add or select a season, then Start Enrollment when ready.

**2️⃣ Enrollment** — Members get a sign-up DM to confirm/decline. Assign confirmed players to each clan's roster (Manage Teams). Notify late joiners and remind pending members as needed.

**3️⃣ Preparation** — Start Preparation DMs every assigned player their clan, tier and start time. Rosters aren't locked yet — last-minute changes are still possible (use Send Roster Updates to notify anyone whose clan changed) right up until a clan's war actually starts, which is when that clan's roster locks.

**4️⃣ War** — Wars run in-game on each clan's own schedule; no action needed here. Delete Season is blocked for good once any clan's war has started, even after everything wraps up — just move on to Setup for the next season.
management.help_details_description:
**1️⃣ Setup**
• *Start New Season* — create the season (draft) to start configuring it.
• *Configure Participating Clans* — pick which clans take part, and set each one's roster size and CWL start time. The CWL league tier itself is determined by Clash of Clans, not set here.
• *Manage CWL Coordinators* — assign up to 2 standing coordinators per clan; this carries over automatically every season. A coordinator is the person who starts the CWL in-game for that clan and is responsible for it all season, so they must be a Leader or Co-Leader in the game. Use *Notify CWL Coordinators* after changing them so they actually find out.
• *Start Enrollment* — moves on to the Enrollment phase once clans are configured.

**2️⃣ Enrollment**
• Every resolved pool member gets a confirm/opt-out sign-up DM (or is auto-confirmed based on their own standing CWL preferences).
• *Notify New Pool Members* — DM anyone who joined the pool after Enrollment opened and hasn't been contacted yet.
• *Remind Pending* — nudge members who still haven't responded.
• *Manage Teams* — assign confirmed members to each clan's roster, up to its roster size.

**3️⃣ Preparation**
• *Start Preparation* — DMs each assigned player their clan, tier and CWL start time. This doesn't lock anything yet — rosters stay editable right up until a clan's war actually starts, which is when that clan's roster locks. Warns first if any roster is still underfilled or any clan has no coordinator set — you can still continue.
• *Send Roster Updates* — re-notify only the players whose clan actually changed since the last announcement.
• Coordinators can still be assigned at any point via *Manage CWL Coordinators*.

**4️⃣ War**
• Wars are fought in Clash of Clans on each clan's own schedule — nothing to do here beyond monitoring.
• *Delete Season* is blocked for good the moment any clan's war has started — that never lifts, even once the season is over. Move on to the next season's *Setup* instead.
